summary: Item 11 Registered Address clips the last letter ('MAKATI CIT') because print-overrides/2553-1999.css forces 7.5px !important. All Part II money amounts (Items 14C-18C, 14E-18E, 19, 20A-20C, 21, 22A-22D, 23) print left-aligned away from the pre-printed decimal dots, and zero/empty boxes print '0.00' instead of blank. Row 18 values entered without picking an ATC combobox option display on screen ('67,890,123.45 · 5') but print '0.00'. Item 17D rate prints '5.00' left-aligned (no '%'), Item 10 phone overflow leaves comb-tick stubs, and screen Row 18 label says '1 rows'.

defects.what: Long registered address is clipped at the right edge ('...MAKATI CIT', cutting off the 'Y') because print-overrides/2553-1999.css forces font-size:7.5px !important over bir-print's dynamic shrink-to-fit.

defects.where: Page 1, Part II Items 14C-18C, 14E-18E, 19, 20A-20C, 21, 22A-22D, and 23 (Computation of Tax)
defects.what: Every Part II money amount prints left-aligned instead of right-aligned (leaving the pre-printed decimal dot stranded on the right), and zero/empty boxes (18C, 18E, 20A, 22A-22D) print '0.00' instead of blank.

Row 18 amount (67,890,123.45) and rate (5) entered by hand on screen display in the row summary ('67,890,123.45 · 5') when no ATC is picked from the combobox, but compute no tax due and print '0.00' in 18C/18D/18E.

defects.where: Page 1, Part II Item 17D and 18D (Tax Rate)
defects.what: Item 17D prints '5.00' left-aligned with no '%' sign (unlike centered '5 %' in 14D-16D), and empty 18D prints '0.00'.

defects.where: Page 1, Part I Item 10 (Telephone Number, 7-slot comb)
defects.what: 11-digit mobile number '09171234567' overflows the 7-slot comb; the shared white band leaves short vertical comb-tick stubs visible at the bottom of the box.
Row counter displays '1 rows' instead of '1 row'.
